content_units: Movie Night Shortlist for Four

A good fit here is   clever, accessible sci-fi/mystery with low gore, English-language, under 130 minutes, and a tone that stays engaging rather than grim  . The list below is ordered from   easiest crowd-pleaser   to   most cerebral  .
Ranked Film Picks
Option 1:   Source Code (2011)     A fast, high-concept mystery thriller that feels smart without getting heavy, making it the safest all-around group pick.     Approx. runtime:   93 min
Option 2:   The Truman Show (1998)     A clever reality-bending premise with mystery, humor, and heart that should land well if you liked thoughtful concept films.     Approx. runtime:   103 min
Option 3:   Minority Report (2002)     A slick sci-fi crime mystery with big ideas and strong momentum, but still very watchable for a mixed group.     Approx. runtime:   145 min
Option 4:   The Adjustment Bureau (2011)     A light, entertaining paranoid sci-fi romance-mystery that stays smart while avoiding bleakness.     Approx. runtime:   106 min
Option 5:   Inside Man (2006)     A tightly written heist mystery with puzzle-box energy and broad crowd appeal, especially for fans of clever reveals.     Approx. runtime:   129 min
Option 6:   Coherence (2013)     A sharp, idea-driven dinner-party sci-fi mystery that rewards attention without relying on gore or horror shocks.     Approx. runtime:   89 min
Option 7:   Moon (2009)     A thoughtful, intimate sci-fi character mystery that will appeal if your group liked the reflective side of  Arrival  and  Ex Machina .     Approx. runtime:   97 min
Option 8:   Predestination (2014)     A very twisty time-travel mystery that is best if your group wants the most mind-bending, discussion-heavy option.     Approx. runtime:   97 min
Best Fit Notes
-   Closest match to your stated vibe:    Source Code ,  Inside Man ,  The Adjustment Bureau
-   Most like your past likes:    Moon  and  Coherence  for  Ex Machina / Arrival  energy
-   Best “everyone will probably enjoy this” pick:    Source Code
-   Best if you want a mystery over sci-fi:    Inside Man
-   Best if you want the biggest post-movie discussion:    Predestination
Viewing Order from Safest to Most Cerebral
Order   Film   Why it sits here   Runtime
1   Source Code   Very accessible, brisk, clever, and easy to get everyone into quickly   93 min
2   The Truman Show   Warm, smart, and broadly appealing with a strong central hook   103 min
3   Inside Man   Crowd-friendly mystery structure with satisfying reveals   129 min
4   The Adjustment Bureau   Light and easy to watch, but a little more concept-forward   106 min
5   Minority Report   Bigger sci-fi ideas and action, though a touch darker and longer   145 min
6   Moon   More reflective and character-driven than the earlier picks   97 min
7   Coherence   Lean, talky, and rewarding if everyone likes paying close attention   89 min
8   Predestination   The most brain-bending and discussion-heavy of the set   97 min
Context for These Picks

I prioritized   smart premise, low gore, English audio, and a not-too-bleak finish or overall feel  . One trade-off:   Minority Report   is a strong tonal fit but runs   over your 130-minute cap  , so treat it as the optional stretch pick.
